metadata.title: Week’s Best: How to Get In on Anthropic’s IPO<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic plans to give individual investors a chance to buy shares of the company when it goes public as early as this month. It anticipates allocating a portion of IPO shares to brokerage customers of Charles Schwab, Fidelity, Robinhood Financial (including its TradePMR unit), SoFi, and Morgan Stanley’s E*Trade, according to a Nov. 2 regulatory filing. However, a sharp market selloff led by AI stocks this week has some investors questioning if the IPO will take place as planned.
